item.title: Cash, M-PESA, or cards? Kenyan banks test a new payments strategy in schools
item.description: Kenyan banks are targeting students with prepaid cards, turning schools into testing ground for a long term race to win future customers.

item.title: Nigeria rules out new standalone crypto law for now
item.description: Nigeria will not rush into passing a new law to govern virtual assets, marking a shift from expectations that Africa’s largest crypto market would move swiftly toward case-by-case legislation.

item.title: MTN moves to take full control of IHS Towers in $2.2 billion deal
item.description: MTN Group, Africa’s largest telecom operator, is moving to take full ownership of IHS Towers in a $2.2 billion deal that would consolidate control of nearly 29,000 telecom towers across Africa.
